# AGENTS.md — Archived records

This tree is frozen. Every file here is a historical snapshot of a decision that was complete when it was archived.

**Do not edit, reformat, update, translate, move, or delete anything under this folder**, and do not treat any of it as authority for how the system behaves today. If an archived record is wrong about the present, that is expected — it describes the past.

Active prose may link into an archived record when it intentionally cites history. The documentation gates skip this tree entirely, including its outbound links, so a dead link here is not a defect.

The archival procedure — what moves, what changes, and what stays — is in [../README.md](../README.md#archiving).
